title.en: Datadog introduces Scout 1.0 for production-incident investigation
title.zhHans: Datadog 推出用于生产事故调查的 Scout 1.0

searchSummary.en: Datadog introduced Scout 1.0, a specialized model powering Bits Investigation for production-alert investigation; Datadog teams and a small customer group are using it in closed preview.
searchSummary.zhHans: Datadog 推出 Scout 1.0，这是一款为生产告警调查提供 Bits Investigation 支持的专用模型；Datadog 团队和一小组客户正在封闭预览中使用它。

summary.en: Datadog introduced Scout 1.0, a specialized model powering Bits Investigation for production-alert investigation; Datadog teams and a small customer group are using it in closed preview.
summary.zhHans: Datadog 推出 Scout 1.0，这是一款为生产告警调查提供 Bits Investigation 支持的专用模型；Datadog 团队和一小组客户正在封闭预览中使用它。

narrative.en: Scout is a closed-preview, domain-specific product rather than an independently measured change in SRE practice. Its performance and cost comparisons are vendor-reported, and general availability remains pending.
narrative.zhHans: Scout 是处于封闭预览阶段的领域专用产品，而非经独立测量的 SRE 工作实践变化。其性能与成本比较来自厂商披露，正式普遍可用仍待后续。

text.en: Datadog introduced Scout 1.0 to power Bits Investigation for production-issue investigation.
text.zhHans: Datadog 推出 Scout 1.0，为生产问题调查提供 Bits Investigation 支持。

text.en: Scout was in closed preview and its performance and cost comparisons were reported by Datadog.
text.zhHans: Scout 仍处于封闭预览，其性能和成本比较由 Datadog 报告。

changeLog.summary: Created as a draft from the 2026-10-08 to 2026-10-16 full discovery sweep.
Gemini 3.8 independent full-evidence review completed; L1 and zero observed impact retained.
